en.title: Rakeback and Bonuses at NUTS: What Players Get and How Not to Miss Out — Nuts PPPoker
en.description: Rakeback, first-deposit bonus, weekly promos and jackpot at the NUTS club on PPPoker. How returns are calculated and how to claim every perk.
en.bodyHtml:
Author: Garik Avetisyan, Head of Loyalty at NUTS

Published: October 2026

Rakeback, deposit bonuses, weekly events, and the club jackpot — rewards only work if you know where to look. Here is the full breakdown.

Rakeback

Rake is the club commission; rakeback returns part of it to you. At NUTS typical range is 30–45% depending on volume. Regulars get personal terms — ask your manager.

First-deposit bonus

  • Min deposit from $10
  • Instant bonus: 10%
  • Progressive bonus: up to 140% with play

Message @NUTSsup before or right after deposit to activate.

Weekly promos & jackpot

Check the club lobby and our Telegram channel. See also Mini Highroller promos.

Referrals

Earn a share of referred players' rake. Not in the club yet? Join guide (ID 111777). Deposits via @NUTS111777_bot.
